download_tfds_dataset: download a tensorflow datasets builder by name and prepare it for use
disable_gpus_on_tensorflow: disable GPU devices on tensorflow by setting visible devices to an empty list
create_VTABIterableDataset: create a PyTorch IterableDataset wrapping a TFDS dataset with image and label transforms
iterate_VTABIterableDataset: iterate over a VTABIterableDataset to yield PIL images and labels with worker sharding
get_VTABIterableDataset_length: get the number of examples in a VTABIterableDataset via its length method
